name: ConFit / IntelliPro
provenance: Hand-maintained: no repo script regenerates this file. Written on 2026-10-19 from $HBM_EXTERNAL_ROOT/confit/MANIFEST.json, the acquirer's full manifest (outside git). bytes and sha256 were measured on the verified raw files and equal that manifest wherever it lists the same file; extracted members were also checked against the archive they come from. A tree_sha256 is scripts/fetch_external_data.py::tree_digest of the directory.

fetch.note: the public release: code plus label files; every text cell is a placeholder

blocked.reason: the public release has no real resume or job text: every text cell is a placeholder such as [[RESUME_TEXT]], so there is nothing to stage.
steps: For IntelliPro text, contact the authors (Xiao Yu / Zhou Yu per the README; no address is given) and request access under their data-use terms.
For AliTianChi text, obtain the original Tianchi competition data with your own Tianchi account and accept its terms.

Either text source joins onto the released label files on the existing user_id / jd_no keys. Any ingestion must hard-reject cells matching ^\[\[[A-Z_]+\]\]$: the placeholders pass the project's length and marker filters.
